# Pikuniku

## What is the goal of Pikuniku when randomized?

Defeat Mr. Sunshine at Sunshine HQ. To get there, you will need the Pencil Hat, the Sunglasses, 
the Magnetic Card, the Water Hat, The Cabin Key, and A Detonator.

## What items and locations get shuffled?

Hats (Pencil Hat, Water Hat, Sunglasses, and cosmetic hats), key items
(Magnetic Card, The Cabin Key, A Detonator, Apples, The Golden Tooth from the Silver Frog),
and all trophies are shuffled into the item pool.

Locations include trophies, dancing bugs, shop purchases, and story progression points such as
defeating the Giant Robots. With Coinsanity enabled, every freestanding coin in the world is also a check,
and "5 Coins" items become progression for shop purchases.

## Disclaimer

Claude was utilized to assist in the creation of mod this mod, including finding spots to hook into the game, helping setup the Archipelago structure, and some other things. All code was checked by myself, and tested to work to the best of my ability.

tutorials.text:
# Pikuniku Randomizer Setup Guide

## Required Software

- [Pikuniku](https://store.steampowered.com/app/572890/Pikuniku/) 
- [Pikuniku Archipelago Mod](https://github.com/Jeffdev-Archipelago-Implementations/PikuAPMod/releases/latest)
- [Archipelago v0.6.7 or higher](https://github.com/ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago/releases)
- [BepInEx 5](https://github.com/BepInEx/BepInEx/releases/tag/v5.4.23.5)

## Generating a game

Generating a multiworld game works like any other Archipelago. You will download the apworld file, put it in your custom_worlds folder, then use the Options Creator to make a yaml and put it into your Players folder. Then click "Generate" on the launcher, and you will have a generated game!
**NOTE: YOU MUST HAVE ARCHIPELAGO v0.6.7 OR HIGHER TO GENERATE AND USE THE PIKUNIKU APWORLD!**

## Installation Steps

1. Open your Pikuniku installation directory. On Steam, you can find it easily by right-clicking the game and clicking `Manage` > `Browse local files`.
2. Extract the contents of the BepInEx zip into the Pikuniku installation directory.
3. Run the game once to have it create all of the folders necessary.
4. Extract the contents of the Pikuniku Archipelago Mod into the plugins folder created in the BepInEx folder.
5. Run the game. If it worked, you should be able to click "Adventure" and it will show an Archipelago connection screen.
